create_SonarSpeechEncoderModel: create a SonarSpeechEncoderModel instance with encoder frontend, transformer encoder, layer norm, dropout, and pooler
build_speech_encoder_pipeline: build a speech encoder pipeline that processes audio sequences through wav2vec2 frontend and transformer encoder
run_encoder_forward_pass: run the forward pass of SonarSpeechEncoderModel to encode audio sequences and produce sentence embeddings
configure_encoder_pooler: configure an encoder output pooler to pool transformer encoder outputs into fixed-size sentence embeddings
apply_layer_norm_and_dropout: apply optional layer normalization and final dropout to transformer encoder outputs
